Disguise.name: Disguise
Disguise.description: Caster changes the target's appearance to another of their choosing. The spell may make the target appear up to one foot shorter or taller. The spell cannot produce dramatic changes such as making a humanoid target non-humanoid and vice versa. The illusion does not hold up to physical interaction. This disguise is an illusion and is subject to illusion detection rules.

Doppleganger.name: Doppleganger
Doppleganger.description: Caster creates an Illusory copy of themselves - though this copy has a few unique properties. The caster can choose to switch positions with the copy as a Swift Action by expending 2 mana. The caster can choose to make their strikes and spells originate from the copy instead of themselves, effectively extending their range. The copy's HP is equal to half of the caster's and has the same DVs. The caster can direct the copy to move up to 60' as a swift action. The copy dissipates if it leaves a 120' +20'/F LOS area around the caster.

Emotional Trickery.name: Emotional Trickery
Emotional Trickery.description: Caster delves into the mind of a target and summons an illusory copy of the person or thing that relates to a chosen emotion or feeling the most, WIL save to negate. The illusion can move anywhere in the LOS as part of any usage of this spell. The illusion can have the sensations of sight, smell, touch, hearing, and taste. If the emotion is love, it shall be what they desire. If it is sorrow, it shall be what brings them sorrow; with four finesses the illusory copy is completely real to the target. Immediately upon casting this spell, and then as a Swift Action during all later turns, the caster can direct this illusion to frighten or convince the target until the end of their next turn as a Swift Action. If the target is frightened, they are frightened of the caster.

Focus Illusion.name: Focus Illusion
Focus Illusion.description: An illusion spell of the caster's choosing remains permanent as long as the caster retains their focus on this spell. The caster may drop the spell at any time as a Swift Action, but this spell and the original ends. This spell functions on Major Illusion, Emotional Trickery, Phantasm, Minor Illusion, or False Reality.

Force Illusion.name: Force Illusion
Force Illusion.description: A wave of energy enshrouds the area - rendering it illusory. The area loses its physical substance - allowing anyone to harmlessly pass through it. If the surface a character is standing on is affected by Force Illusion, that character has an AGI save to move to a location outside of its effect. This spell does not affect sentient targets.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description: Willing targets become invisible until the end of this spell. Anything being worn, equipped, or carried by the invisible targets also becomes invisible. This spell ends when targets come in physical contact with another creature in any way, when the targets make any check or save, or when they force another target to make a check or save.

Illusory Life.name: Illusory Life
Illusory Life.description: Caster sends out a wave of energy towards the targets, WIL check to negate. They become illusory, allowing the caster to disable any number of the following senses in them and disable other creatures' ability to use the following senses to perceive them; sight, smell, touch, hearing, and taste. (For example, a target with disabled sight is invisible but also blind, a target with disabled hearing is silent but deaf, etc). Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Major Illusion.name: Major Illusion
Major Illusion.description: Caster creates an illusion of their choosing in the target area. This illusion may have the sensory properties of - sight, smell, touch, hearing, and taste to fool the basic senses; the illusion's ability to cause harm is dependent upon how believable it is. The caster can continuously change the illusions within the area of Major Illusion by expending their Core Action, and any illusions within the area of effect can act independently of the caster. A target gets an AGI save to move to the nearest safe location, instead of falling if the illusion is modified to remove the floor from under them.

Mirror Image.name: Mirror Image
Mirror Image.description: 4 + 1/F illusory duplicates of the caster are created in spaces adjacent to them. By default, duplicates mimic every part of the caster's actions, confusing enemies and making them unable to tell which of the duplicates is the real caster. Immediately after casting the spell and afterward as a Swift Action, the caster may command every illusion to move. The illusions have a movement speed equal to the caster. The duplicates have no physical presence, and their nature is revealed when they are struck or damaged. For illusion detection, each duplicate is an individual illusion.

Minor Illusion.name: Minor Illusion
Minor Illusion.description: Caster creates an illusion of their choosing in the target area. This illusion may have and produce a continuous stream of sensory properties of - sight, smell, hearing, and taste to fool the basic senses, though the caster may only choose up to (Rank/2) of these sensations. The illusion has a maximum movement speed of 30', the caster can move the illusion utilizing their Swift Action. No illusion produced by this spell can create sensory stimuli so strong that it causes harm.

Phantasmal Attacker.name: Phantasmal Attacker
Phantasmal Attacker.description: A phantasmal fighter appears adjacent to the target, following them wherever they go whenever they move. Phantasmal fighters have DVs equal to the target they follow. Phantasmal fighters dissipate when their associated target makes a successful attack roll against them. While a phantasmal fighter is adjacent to the target, they receive two displaced rolls on attack rolls against creatures other than their phantasmal fighter.

Perfect Distortion.name: Perfect Distortion
Perfect Distortion.description: Willing targets become invisible for the spell's duration. Anything being worn or equipped by the invisible targets also becomes invisible. This invisibility is not lost upon interacting with creatures, attacking, or taking any other actions, though such actions may reveal a target's current position to an enemy.

Phantasm.name: Phantasm
Phantasm.description: Caster creates a phantom up to 10' tall, 10' wide, 10' deep that can continuously move in the area - with an accompanying flight speed of 30'. Caster may use their Swift Action to direct the phantasm to attack a target within the LOS, making a melee attack roll. The phantasm inflicts 2 + 1/2F d6 stress damage on a successful strike. This phantom can have visual, auditory, temperature, or smell properties. When creating the phantom, caster can choose any combination of these properties - though it must hold a visual property of some sort.

Phantasmal Defender.name: Phantasmal Defender
Phantasmal Defender.description: Caster creates a phantasm (resembling them) that shares a space with them and persists with Focus. It is invisible to those without ranks in illusion. The caster can direct the phantasm using their Core Action (granting it a core and movement action) to manipulate objects (Such as weapons) or cast abilities as if it were the caster, observe a target (memlock and maintain LOS even if the caster cannot), with the same skill as the caster. The phantasm shares all DVs and attributes with the caster - any damage done to the phantasm is reflected onto the caster. Once cast, this spell can be toggled on and off using a Swift Action - though it can be interrupted as though it were a focus spell.

Phantasmal Evasion.name: Phantasmal Evasion
Phantasmal Evasion.description: Caster gains the ability to create illusory clones that take the place of the caster, allowing them to dodge. For the duration of the ability, the target may use their reaction to prepare 2 + 1/3F illusory clones. The caster may expend a clone at no action cost to dodge an attack by allowing a clone to take the hit and jumping out of the way (up to 10'.) This ability may be used to dodge physical and magical attacks, but sufficiently magical spells (rank 6 and above) cannot be blocked in this way. Additionally, the caster may only dodge an area of effect if the 10' jump is enough to take them out of the radius.

Probe.name: Probe
Probe.description: Caster probes the minds of the targets, should they have one, WIL save to negate. The caster can truthfully glean a question about the targets - though the question must be answered with a 'Yes' or 'No.' For 24 hours after being affected by Probe, targets get a displaced roll to detect illusions made by the caster and checks to resist the caster's Illusion spells.
